card.name: Words before viewing or printing images
card.fires_on: Small linking words (for, and, then, he, would, the) where the next word is likely about viewing, playing back, printing or sending a captured image or photo. Also the heading "Image Display and Interpretation" in imaging labels.

modes.label: Photo handling
modes.description: Linking word in a story about taking photos or film and then processing, sending or examining them.

modes.label: Image display heading
modes.description: The word "Image" or "and" inside the imaging label heading "Image Display and Interpretation".

card.writes: Pushes toward words about playback, printing and retrieving, and away from sensor words.
card.plain: It lights up on small words just before text about viewing, printing or retrieving a captured image.
